deadline.value: Apply by December 1 (EEB, GCDB, Microbiology); no extensions.

also.quote: Applications for Fall 2027 will open September 1, 2026, for all programs.

fee_waiver.value: The department gives no waivers; only some Graduate School waivers exist.
fee_waiver.quote: The Department of Biology does not currently offer graduate application fee waivers or reimbursements. | The Graduate School Bloomington offers some waivers.

toefl_min.value: Minimum recommended TOEFL iBT 79; IELTS 6.5; Duolingo 115.
toefl_min.quote: The minimum recommended scores for admission to the IU Bloomington Graduate Biology program are: IELTS – 6.5 TOEFL – 79

ielts_min.quote: The minimum recommended scores for admission to the IU Bloomington Graduate Biology program are: IELTS – 6.5 TOEFL – 79

english_waiver.value: Waiver only for citizens of English-official countries on IU's list or degrees from the US, UK or Canada; India is not on IU's list, so a test is required.
english_waiver.quote: Citizens of a country where English is the official language and/or students that have a degree from a higher education institution in the United States, United Kingdom, or Canada do not need to submit English Language test results.

supervisor.value: You do not need a lab picked out; most students pick a lab after the first semester.
supervisor.quote: Students do not need to have a lab picked out when they apply.

funding.value: All admitted PhD students get a stipend and fee remission; support is guaranteed for 5 years.

entry_route.value: Entry requires an undergraduate major in biology or a related science.
entry_route.quote: Minimum entrance requirements include an undergraduate major in one of the biological sciences or in a related field such as chemistry, physics, or mathematics.

notes: Covers Evolution, Ecology and Behavior; Genome, Cell and Developmental Biology; and Microbiology PhDs.
